correctness.rationale: PASS — Recomputed ordered-spacings Dirichlet reparameterization, mixed E[|X1-X2|Q] using U=X1/(X1+X2) uniform and beta splitting, yielding (2m+5)/(m(m+1)(m+2)); verifies covariance (m−1)/(2m(m+1)(m+2)). Rank-gradient representation gives Var G=(m−1)/(12m²); standard Dirichlet moments give Var Q=4(m−1)/((m+1)²(m+2)(m+3)). Direct expansion T=Q−G/m−constant yields the exact rational Var T, mean and correlation. For the CLT, checked exponential-normalization influence functions a(E)=(E−3)/2+2e^(−E), b(E)=E²−4E+2 with covariance matrix [[1/12,1/2],[1/2,4]], so Var(b−a)=37/12. The m=2 boundary is valid. Independently recomputed exact rational ordered-simplex moments m=2..9; analytic proofs, not finite extrapolation, give all m and limit.

originality.rationale: PASS, qualified — Jammalamadaka–Goria 2004 already defines the ranked-spacing statistic and its Gini–Greenwood decomposition; those elements are prior, as the primary PDF p.183 shows. Tung–Jammalamadaka 2012 gives broad asymptotic U-statistic CLT machinery, so that method is prior too. Neither inspected theorem evaluates the exact finite-m G/Q covariance and nontrivial positive correlation or Var(T); the paper explicitly highlights dependence as a problem. Limit variance 37/12 is a specialization of known CLT framework. Unindexed finite-sample calculation remains possible.
residual_risks: Unindexed pre-2012 spacing correlation or Dirichlet moment identities may state exactly this covariance.
General U-statistic CLT and the test statistic themselves are prior; no finite-sample null density/quantiles established.

value.rationale: PASS — Finite-sample calibration for an already published goodness-of-fit test is a motivated exact statistical invariant: Gini and Greenwood remain strongly dependent (Corr→√3/2), and the mixed covariance corrects the test variance and its asymptotic constant from the independence-based incorrect 49/12 to 37/12.
